meta.description: 按月份预生成的时令饮食建议，中英双语。根据 config.json 的 location 字段自动匹配深圳/香港时令。

tips.zh: 冬季宜温补，可多食羊肉、牛肉、鸡肉等温性食材，搭配山药、红枣健脾养胃。
tips.en: Winter is good for warm nourishment. Eat more lamb, beef, and chicken. Pair with yam and red dates to strengthen spleen and stomach.

tips.zh: 深圳1月偶有寒潮，注意早餐温热，粥品可加姜片驱寒。
tips.en: Shenzhen may have cold snaps in January. Keep breakfast warm; add ginger slices to porridge to dispel cold.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：白萝卜、大白菜、菠菜、莲藕，适合炖汤和温炒。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: white radish, napa cabbage, spinach, lotus root. Great for soups and warm stir-fries.

tips.zh: 春节前后饮食易过量，建议节后清淡调理，多食小米粥、山药粥养胃。
tips.en: Around Chinese New Year, overeating is common. Post-holiday, eat light: millet porridge and yam porridge to soothe the stomach.

tips.zh: 初春韭菜当季，温中行气，适合做韭菜炒蛋或韭菜饺子。
tips.en: Chinese chives are in season in early spring. Warming and good for digestion. Try chive & egg stir-fry or chive dumplings.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：韭菜、春笋、荠菜、豆苗。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: Chinese chives, spring bamboo shoots, shepherd's purse, pea shoots.

tips.zh: 春季肝气旺盛，宜少酸多甘，多食山药、红枣、南瓜等甘味食材。
tips.en: In spring, liver energy is active. Reduce sour, increase sweet foods like yam, red dates, and pumpkin.

tips.zh: 深圳3月气温回暖，可开始增加绿叶蔬菜比例，但 still 保持温热烹饪。
tips.en: Shenzhen warms up in March. Increase leafy greens but keep cooking methods warm.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：菠菜、荠菜、春笋、豌豆尖、枸杞叶。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: spinach, shepherd's purse, spring bamboo shoots, pea shoots, goji leaves.

tips.zh: 谷雨时节湿气渐重，建议煲汤加入薏米、赤小豆祛湿。
tips.en: During Grain Rain, dampness increases. Add barley and adzuki beans to soups to dispel dampness.

tips.zh: 春夏交替，注意食材新鲜度，海鲜类需彻底加热。
tips.en: Spring-summer transition: ensure ingredient freshness. Seafood must be thoroughly cooked.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：苋菜、空心菜、丝瓜、苦瓜开始上市。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: amaranth, water spinach, luffa, bitter melon begin to appear.

tips.zh: 立夏后气温升高，饮食宜清淡但保持温热，可多食瓜类蔬菜。
tips.en: After Start of Summer, eat light but keep food warm. More gourd vegetables recommended.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：丝瓜、苦瓜、冬瓜、黄瓜、番茄。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: luffa, bitter melon, winter melon, cucumber, tomato.

tips.zh: 夏季脾胃易虚弱，早餐粥品可加莲子、芡实健脾。
tips.en: Summer weakens the spleen and stomach. Add lotus seeds and gordon euryale seeds to breakfast porridge.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：苋菜、空心菜、秋葵、茄子、豆角。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: amaranth, water spinach, okra, eggplant, long beans.

tips.zh: 盛夏酷暑，饮食宜清淡温热，避免冰饮冷食伤脾胃。
tips.en: Midsummer heat: eat light and warm. Avoid ice-cold drinks that harm the spleen.

tips.zh: 深圳7月高温高湿，食材易变质，建议当天采购当天烹饪。
tips.en: Shenzhen in July: hot and humid. Ingredients spoil easily. Buy and cook same day.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：秋葵、苋菜、空心菜、丝瓜、苦瓜、玉米。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: okra, amaranth, water spinach, luffa, bitter melon, corn.

tips.zh: 立秋后可开始温和进补，初秋宜润燥，多食百合、银耳、雪梨（炖煮）。
tips.en: After Start of Autumn, begin gentle nourishment. Early autumn: moisten dryness with lily bulb, snow fungus, stewed pear.

tips.zh: 深圳8月仍炎热，但早晚温差开始变化，注意早餐温热。
tips.en: Shenzhen still hot in August, but day-night temperature shifts begin. Keep breakfast warm.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：莲藕、山药、芋头开始上市，适合煲汤。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: lotus root, yam, taro begin to appear. Great for soups.

tips.zh: 白露时节秋燥明显，建议多食润肺食材：百合、银耳、山药、莲藕。
tips.en: White Dew: autumn dryness is evident. Eat lung-moistening foods: lily bulb, snow fungus, yam, lotus root.

tips.zh: 中秋前后蟹肥，但全家温热饮食原则下，建议姜葱炒蟹或蟹粥，避免生醉。
tips.en: Around Mid-Autumn, crabs are plump. Following warm-food rule: stir-fry with ginger/scallion or make crab porridge. Avoid raw/drunk crab.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：莲藕、山药、芋头、南瓜、板栗。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: lotus root, yam, taro, pumpkin, chestnut.

tips.zh: 深秋渐凉，可增加温补菜品，如当归生姜羊肉汤、板栗炖鸡。
tips.en: Late autumn cooling: add warming dishes like angelica & ginger lamb soup, chestnut stewed chicken.

tips.zh: 秋季南瓜当季，营养丰富，可做南瓜小米粥、南瓜蒸排骨。
tips.en: Pumpkin is in season. Nutritious: try pumpkin millet porridge or steamed pumpkin with pork ribs.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：南瓜、板栗、山药、莲藕、白萝卜。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: pumpkin, chestnut, yam, lotus root, white radish.

tips.zh: 立冬后正式进补季节，可适量食用羊肉、牛肉、鹿茸等温补食材。
tips.en: After Start of Winter, it's nourishment season. Eat warming foods: lamb, beef, deer antler velvet in moderation.

tips.zh: 深圳11月早晚转凉，早餐粥品可加红枣、桂圆温补气血。
tips.en: Shenzhen cools in November mornings/evenings. Add red dates and longan to breakfast porridge for warmth.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：白萝卜、大白菜、菠菜、茼蒿、山药。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: white radish, napa cabbage, spinach, chrysanthemum greens, yam.

tips.zh: 冬至前后最宜进补，可食当归生姜羊肉汤、人参炖鸡等温补药膳。
tips.en: Around Winter Solstice, best time for nourishment: angelica & ginger lamb soup, ginseng stewed chicken.

tips.zh: 冬季干燥，需注意补充温热汤水，少食辛辣燥热之物。
tips.en: Winter is dry. Supplement with warm soups. Reduce spicy and drying foods.

tips.zh: 当季时蔬：白萝卜、大白菜、菠菜、莲藕、山药、红薯。
tips.en: Seasonal vegetables: white radish, napa cabbage, spinach, lotus root, yam, sweet potato.
